dish.n: Street cart hot dogs with sauerkraut
dish.note: Frankfurts in soft rolls with mustard, sauerkraut and fried onion, off the cart.
dish.how: Fry 2 sliced onions in 1 tbsp oil for 15 minutes until soft and golden. Simmer 8 frankfurts in hot water for 6 minutes, or grill until browned. Warm 8 soft hot dog rolls and fill with a frankfurt, onion, 200g drained sauerkraut and yellow mustard, with extra mustard and tomato sauce to pass around.

steps.text: Fry the sliced onions slowly until soft and golden.
Warm the rolls and fill with frankfurt, onion, sauerkraut and mustard.

dish.make_ahead: Fry the onions up to 1 day ahead and reheat
